name: Lactaid 100% Lactose-Free Whole / 2% Milk
whyItWorks: Real farm-fresh dairy milk pre-treated with natural lactase enzymes that convert all lactose disaccharides into simple, easily absorbed glucose and galactose. Delivers 8g of complete protein, calcium, and vitamin D with zero lactose bloating or diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold, pour over cereal, or use 1:1 in any recipe calling for milk.
watchOuts: Contains real dairy milk protein (casein and whey); safe for lactose intolerance, but not for severe IgE milk allergies.
